text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's miraculous advice booth 
became an everyday staple for the 
students—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Got it! If you go with green curtains, 
I bet you'll love how it turns out!

text_block_list.name: Inquirer
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Ahh, bless you, truly bless 
you! 
Please, accept these mature cosmetics 
as my humble tribute...!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really want to ask Lady Mayano 
about 
the next pop quiz... but the line's always 
packed lately.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, that's where tricks come in. Lady 
Mayano loves 
mature items—bring an offering like that, 
and she'll take your case in no time!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
! I didn't think of that! Alright, then 
I'll 
go find some mature items too—

text_block_list.name: Inquirers
text_block_list.text:
"Listen to my problem next, please!" 
"N-No, I was first! Here, take my 
tribute!" 
"Me... Me... Pick me...!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa?! Everybody, calm down~! 
I don't even need offerings, seriously~?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Point Check☆ 
Hmm~... looks like Mayano's running a 
little low on steam!★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... It's just... I'm really happy 
that everyone comes to talk to Maya, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It feels like they're just relying on Maya 
for literally everything... 
Is this really okay~?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Sounds like Mayano needs 
a Marvelous recharge!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Can I bring someone with a problem to 
see you next time? 
I'm sure it'll lead to something 
marvelous!☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, sure, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, Mayano! 
I brought someone who needs advice!☆

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello...! 
Ah... It-It's really Mayano-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I haven't seen you before! 
What kind of problem do you need solved?

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I really look up to you, 
Mayano-san... 
And... I was wondering if maybe 
we could run together today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's easy-peasy! 
Let's warm up and get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Vroooom—and that's the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that! 
Maya got a little carried away!

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I knew it would 
end up like this anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. A time like this is when I 
should 
give her advice on how to improve her 
running—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, got it! 
So, what you should do is—

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—B-But! Even I managed 
to notice something just now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run, Mayano-san, made me 
think... 
It's like, coordinating your body and legs 
together... 
or finding a rhythm, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Kind of like this... I-I don't know 
if I'm doing it right, though...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That looks great! 
Hang onto that feeling!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Phew, you gave it your all till the very 
end today! 
And I could totally tell how much thought 
you were putting into every stride!

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. 
...I can't run in all kinds of different 
styles 
the way you do, Mayano-san...

text_block_list.name: Little Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
But... by watching you run closely, 
thinking it over, 
and training, I thought maybe... 
it's something I could figure out for 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Petite Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
And then, maybe someday... I can shine 
just as bright as you, Mayano-san... Or so 
I hope...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...You totally will! I know it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You know, I actually learned 
a whole bunch today too! 
Let's run together again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm-hmm, hmm-hmmm♪ 
Maya's got it all figured out~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Booo, not that! I mean I figured out 
how I should be advising everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Yep, Maya just took another step 
toward becoming a mature woman!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Just watch! I'm gonna show everyone 
a totally mature way to solve problems!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Maya realized something else, too. 
Teaching someone else is a total shortcut 
to growing up!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll put everything I learned to good 
use... 
and teach everyone what they 
really need to know!
